variants.label: 12-night canonical plan
variants.notes: The checked-in itinerary is the immutable comparison baseline: Athens 2 nights + Naxos 4 + Paros 2 + Milos 3 + Athens 1 buffer, ferries outbound through the islands and a Milos->Athens domestic flight home, with a rental car on each island.

sourceLocators.internal-itinerary: Greek Cyclades; variant canonical; route-specific savings/tradeoffs require re-price

alternateNotes: Two alternatives are worth documenting but are not yet cost-reconciled. (1) A leaner three-island cut that drops Paros (Athens 2 + Naxos 4 + Milos 4 + Athens 1) removes one ferry and one base move, trimming cost and logistics at the expense of Naoussa and Kolymbithres — it would need its own reconciliation and a re-scored ease/budget. (2) A calmer single-island fallback (Naxos or Milos only) if the meltemi forecast looks severe near travel, cutting ferry-cancellation exposure but losing the multi-island variety. Both need re-pricing before they can be treated as ranked variants.
